literature_boundary: See LITERATURE.md. Finite-field/modal teleportation and ordinary tight teleportation classifications have prior art, as does categorical teleportation over generalized scalar systems. The narrower CM result is the explicit unit-determinant/Smith-(0,0) necessary-and-sufficient criterion over F2[u]/(u^4), together with the separation between contextuality strength and exact teleportation power. Ordinary complex conclusive teleportation with partially entangled resources is established prior art; the CM postselection no-go is narrower and depends on nonunit/zero-divisor Smith factors and residue-rank obstruction.
